content:
Priya: hey folks, new hire here (Priya, platform). two quick obs onboarding issues: 1) Datadog dashboards under /platform/team are empty for me (shows 'No Dashboards'), 2) my Sentry project list doesn't show errors for the service i'm paired with. anyone seen this?
Elliot: welcome! for Datadog, did you accept the invite or use SSO? sometimes folder perms don't propagate after a team rename.
Priya: accepted via SSO and email shows accepted.
devex-bot: Datadog access runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/devex/datadog-onboard. If dashboards missing file ticket DD-UI-assign with your team and email.
infra-oncall: i checked quickly  your account lacked the group binding to the 'platform' Datadog folder due to a sync race. granted Reader role; give it ~2 mins and refresh.
Priya: refreshed and dashboards show up, thanks. quick follow-up: monitor alerts tab still empty, and i can't see 'Manage Monitors' button.
Elliot: Monitors require 'Editor' or specific monitor perms. we avoid giving Editor broadly; request temporary Editor window in the DD ticket and list justification.
Priya: noted. about Sentry: accepted invite but project errors missing; SDK is definitely sending events.
Marta: Sentry PM here. sometimes Sentry hides projects until you are added as a Project Member vs Org Member. i'll add you to the project now. also check the SSO org id mapping in the invite flow.
Priya: i can see the project now and events are populating. thanks all. couple of docs that helped: dd runbook link above and Sentry SSO checklist: https://wiki.redwood.com/security/sentry-sso.
Elliot: pro tip: if you need to debug a noisy monitor test, use a short time range and clone dashboards or filters to avoid hitting guardrails. also ping infra-oncall for temporary perms rather than asking for permanent Editor.
Priya: will do. really appreciate the fast help. marking this resolved for my access issues. :wave:
